recentItems.description:
Union Home Minister Amit Shah has set December 31, 2029, as the target for making India drug-free. Speaking at the Police Commemoration Day event in Delhi, he urged police forces nationwide to work together to combat drug trafficking and substance abuse. He also paid tribute to police personnel who sacrificed their lives in the line of duty and launched an anti-drug motorcycle rally involving 90 police personnel from nine states and Union Territories.
